discovery_notes: Follow-up 4 of B007 (packets 207, 413, 456, 489); reuses their keys. 30 standard searches, snippets only. New: HKDL July (Timon key, Cinderella, Tiana) and August (Pinocchio key, Belle, Mulan, Pluto birthday) LE pins from Hong Kong Main Street Gazette; Seven Dwarfs HM seven pins (DPB + UPN); Baby HM second six, Alice HM seven and Glove HM two (UPN only, held); 14th-anniv Mickey/Minnie/Goofy LE500 and Christmas tree LE500 (MyPinCentral); TDR cherry blossom resolved as 2-pin set; TDL Easter pin; Hot Jungle Summer price/date. No existing holds released except cherry blossom structure (new per-pin evidence). Resellers, Carousell, Suruga-ya and Pin Trader Club not used as evidence.
